thread:
maria (partner-eng): FYI — our SI partner (NorthStar) is blocked on the private deployment handoff with DeltaHealth. They hit two blockers: KMS access and an unexpected NAT/gateway requirement.

jamal (solutions): Can we get an architecture review ASAP? Customer has a Friday go/no-go with their infra team.

olivia (eng-arch): I can jump on a call in 30m. What specifically is failing? Any logs or error messages?

noah (si): The agent fails during bootstrap with: 
```
ERROR: failed to fetch key ARN arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111111:key/abcde - AccessDeniedException
Traceback: PermissionDenied
```
Also their network team requires outbound NAT to a specific IP range for model downloads (we thought S3 endpoints + VPC endpoints would suffice).

maria (partner-eng): Customer says they cannot change their org KMS policy, so we need an architecture pattern that avoids requiring cross-account KMS access.

sam (security): We should NOT ask them to relax KMS policies. Options: 1) use customer-managed key in their account with our deployment running under cross-account role (requires their approval) or 2) bring model artifacts into their S3 bucket ahead of time and use instance profile access. Which is feasible for SI?

noah (si): Option 2 looks quickest. NorthStar can pre-stage artifacts and provide a manifest. But the installer still needs to write logs to our metrics collector (we can switch to HTTPS endpoint). NAT requirement still remains for pulling container images from ECR/GCR.

olivia (eng-arch): For images we can mirror to a private registry inside their VPC (or to a customer-controlled ECR repo). We'll add a toggle to the deploy script: `--use-local-registry` so SI can point to their repo. For the KMS issue, create a local key wrapper that uses instance profile to decrypt a locally staged envelope key — effectively avoiding cross-account KMS calls. I'll draft a minimal change.

jamal (solutions): Great. Can you outline the changes and send them to NorthStar + DeltaHealth? Also tag infra and security so they can review.

maria (partner-eng): I'll set up a stakeholder thread and schedule the architecture review today at 3pm ET. @olivia please bring the deploy script patch and a short runbook. @noah please bring the manifest and sample error logs.

deploy-bot: Deployment check triggered by noah — preflight failed (missing registry credentials). See https://deploys.redwood/1755004321 for details. :warning:

noah (si): A couple quick asks for eng: 1) Can we get a small example for the envelope-key pattern? 2) Is there a recommended NAT proxy pattern for environments that only allow egress via approved gateways?

olivia (eng-arch): We'll prepare a gist with a 2-file example (bootstrap + decrypt helper) and a short network diagram showing a proxy/NAT instance pattern. I'll also include the `--use-local-registry` flag in the installer README.

sam (security): I'll review the gist and verify it adheres to our compliance requirements (no long-lived plaintext keys, audit logs for decrypt ops).

maria (partner-eng): Thanks team — goal is to unblock NorthStar so they can finish the handoff by Friday. I'll post meeting invite and add the preflight checklist to the doc. Please drop any pre-review notes here so we can triage before the call. :thumbsup:

noah (si): Appreciate it. If we can get the gist + patch in the next 2 hours, NorthStar can test tonight.

jamal (solutions): Copy. If anything slips, we'll escalate to dedicated infra support.

maria (partner-eng): Leaving this thread open for updates, will post meeting link shortly. :eyes:
